# RAX

Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents

**2026-10-15 · Preprint · Harvard University**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22496)** · [Project](https://robot-agent-exploration.com/) · [Code](https://github.com/robot-agent-exploration/rax) · [Data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/robot-agent-exploration/robot-session-logs)

Coding agents turn online RGB-D exploration into reusable programs and skills across simulation and physical robot embodiments.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/rax-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Figure 2 : System architecture and self-improving loop of RAX. The coding agent, powered by a frozen LLM, interacts with physical hardware across an isolation boundary using multimodal perception and control SDK interfaces. By reflecting on execution outcomes, the agent continually updates a persistent memory system containing working context, task notes, and a versioned repository of verified skills. During exploration, the agent compiles its perception and planning logic into standalone Python"/>

**Scope and qualifications**

- Not an official RoboDojo live-leaderboard entry: seven-task paper experiments have their own exploration/evaluation budgets.
- DexJoCo receives three completion images, not action demonstrations; HumanoidArena supplies three teleoperated demonstrations only during exploration.
- BEHAVIOR evaluates five agent-in-loop tasks; three receive reviewer reports from the other nine public test instances. This cross-instance feedback differs from isolated test episodes.
- RGB-only ablations must not be confused with the primary calibrated RGB-D setting.
